title: DAF CF Fups Compliant Custom Built Polished Aluminium Bullbar #6
description: DAF CF105 Euro 6 Polished Hi-Tensile Aluminium Custom EBS & FUPS Compatible Bull Bar, features heavy duty box uprights for maximum protection plus dual centre mini uprights for additional protection. 76mm diameter high tensile aluminium tubing with pressed high tensile main channel, the two main cross tubes are one piece and pass fully through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. High tensile aluminium backing plate, (saves 70Kg) with 38mm tow pin. Recessed lights in main channel and driving light mounts to customer specification. Oversize signs on reversible plates plus Dangerous Goods sign mounted on 10mm mounting plate. The bullbar can be customised to suit your application.
